title: a command handler whose loop saves a row per iteration and then fails on a later row keeps none of its saves
note: Gate for D-HANDLER-TX (docs/decisions).  A command handler is one transaction on every backend.  Node, .NET and Elixir opened one only for an expected-failure result or a write-scope re-check, so a plain handler kept the rows its loop saved before a later row failed; Java (`@Transactional`) and Python (the request transaction) already rolled back.

unknown{no-rule}.why: the `page: { offset, limit }` object literal of a paged repository read: the pass has no rule for it
